verdict: Leads are efficient this period, but three open items need closing fast.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 123 leads at an average cost of $10.77 per lead — and the most recent week shows that cost dropping another 35% even as spend pulled back, which means the budget is reaching higher-intent people. The spend reduction is the main concern: daily ad spend fell from roughly $65 to $26 this week, and at that pace the August volume target is at risk. Three overdue deliverables — phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, and a closed-loop reporting dashboard — are being resolved before the August 31 scoreboard deadline, because without them we cannot confirm how many leads turned into booked appointments. Ad spend is being monitored daily and the retargeting-heavy mix that is driving efficiency will be maintained while budget levels are corrected.

watch_item.issue: Daily ad spend dropped sharply this week, putting August lead volume at risk — and attribution gaps mean we cannot yet connect leads to booked appointments.
watch_item.fix: Spend levels are being corrected now, and phone-match attribution plus contact cleanup are being completed ahead of the August 31 reporting deadline.
